ai_jobs.plain_thesis: We think wider AI adoption keeps demand strong for India's IT & software companies over the next 6 months. Across 32 past 6-month windows, an equal bundle of 7 such companies earned about +11.9% on average — ahead of the Nifty's +5.7% — and beat the market about 2 out of 3 times. Nothing here is guaranteed; this is analysis, not financial advice.
ai_jobs.description: More companies adopting AI means more demand for the software and services Indian IT firms sell.
bullets: What drives it: AI adoption lifts demand for Indian IT & software work.
How to act: own an equal bundle of 7 AI/IT companies for a few months.
Main caveat: if the whole market falls, the bundle usually falls too.

yes.summary: If AI adoption keeps lifting demand for India's IT and software firms, owning that bundle directly captures it.

no.summary: If AI doesn't clearly separate IT from the rest of the market, a concentrated bundle adds risk without a real edge — the index is the calmer default.

ai_jobs.caveat: If the whole market falls, the bundle usually falls too.
